summary: Sound Point Meridian Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events disclosing management's unaudited estimate of the range of net asset value per share of common stock as of April 30, 2026, between $10.53 and $10.63. This is a routine NAV update typical for a closed-end fund or BDC. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation event is reported. The filing contains no mention of mergers, tender offers, activist campaigns, restructuring, or any other special situation category. Therefore, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
